_about: Example configuration for scripts/check_tdd_compliance.py. Copy to your repository root as tdd-check.config.json and adapt the globs to your layout. Globs support ** and one level of {a,b} alternation.
_keywords_comment: Added test content must contain at least one of these (case-insensitive). Tune per stack: add your framework's assertion idioms, keep the HTTP status codes.

areas._comment: One area per independently-tested codebase part. Pairing is enforced per area: a Go test cannot satisfy a missing web test.
